Results show consistent prediction of selection ratings and decisions and postselection performance with uncorrected grand averages across dictionaries and studies in the low .20 s for selection ratings and nearer .10 for performance criteria, incremental prediction beyond traditional assessments (mental ability and personality tests), measurement of constructs like motivation and personality without using self-scoring, and small gender and racioethnic subgroup differences. We close with theoretical and practical implications to show that dictionaries are explainable, generalizable, straightforward to content validate, useful for passively scoring information already gathered, accessible to researchers with typical statistical skills, can add incremental prediction to common existing measures, can capture previously difficult-to-measure constructs like motivation, and may help address the validity-adverse impact trade-off. ob.tldr: 聚焦人员选拔中对叙述式申请材料的被动评分，利用自然语言处理词字典提取文本信号，以实现可解释、可泛化且具有增量预测价值的筛选，并降低算法评分对个体的不利影响。

title: Natural language processing word dictionaries for personnel selection: Achieving explainable, generalizable, and incremental prediction with low impact when passively scoring narrative application information.
